summary: A worker seeking warmth finds {workplace}'s foreman sitting in an office just as cold as the shop.
realLife: In the Baltimore machine shop a machinist tried the foreman's office after the furnace broke down and found it offered no relief. They discussed the cold before the shift began.
gates: The case record identifies the heating failure, shift and foreman's firsthand observation.
inGame: needs: heating failure, shift and foreman's firsthand observation.

turns.what: The foreman can corroborate conditions outside the work area.
Workers can ask whether it can serve as a temporary warming area.
